description: Status of the SpyWinAds desktop app on the user's computer: no_app (not installed / not paired), app_off (not seen for 5+ minutes), fb_paused (Facebook temporarily limited the home network, with the time scanning resumes), scanning or idle, plus jobs running and waiting. Scans only run while the app is open on the user's computer.
name: spywin_get_my_scanner_status
title: My SpyWinAds app status
